rounds: Two weeks of showing up in the same gear, same routine, same 'going through the motions' — the Joy Police love a comfortable rut. But Matt's still wearing the Apollo ring to work, every day, with a half-naked man on his finger. That's not nothing. They just got loud the second someone noticed.
pattern: They're fine with the symbols until someone sees them.
focus: One real answer, one week — next time someone asks about the ring, you get to say literally anything except nothing.
